# Notification Assumptions Note 4

We assume that notification handling of mute interacts with suppression; teams noted that push depends on bounce and deliverability, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that notification handling of preference interacts with inbox; teams noted that webhook depends on opt-in and channel, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: notification handling of quiethours interacts with fanout; teams noted that unsubscribe depends on retrypolicy and delivery, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that notification handling of deeplink interacts with subscriber; teams noted that digestcadence depends on template and deliverywindow, especially under real production load.
